shipped.title: michaelmonetized/omatainer · #509 NS7 + stage controllers, #510 waveforms + MIDI
shipped.summary: Two big open PRs. #509 brings the original Numark NS7 back on Linux (four-channel playback, motors, scratching, MIDI) with dedicated Pioneer DDJ-SP1, APC40 mkII and MPD232 mappings. #510 replaces blocky waveforms with detailed stereo, eight-band meshes and adds MIDI step entry, CC/bend lanes, M3U/iTunes playlist import and verified Linux updates. Both open; not counted.
